text: start analysis loading footprinting data level individual reads (example working summary-level data, see vignette("using-footprintR")). Read-level data can extracted modBam files (standard bam file modification data stored MM ML tags, see SAMtags.pdf) using readModBam(). preferred way described . Alternatively, read-level modification data can also extracted modBam files using modkit (see readModkitExtract() read output generated modkit extract). footprintR package contains small example modBam files generated using Dorado aligner: Modification data read files using readModBam(): create RangedSummarizedExperiment object positions rows: Just like summary-level data, columns correspond samples sample names sample column obtained input files (extractfiles), files named automatically assigned (using "s1", "s2" , assuming file corresponds separate sample). text: Summarized data can obtained read-level data calculating per-position summary reads sample: discussed , correctly exclude non-observed values return zero values (count assays "Nmod", “Nvalid”) NaN assays fractions ("FracMod", "Pmod" "AvgConf"), positions without observed data (see example "Pmod" "sample2"): summary statistics calculate selected using statistics argument. default, flattenReadLevelAssay() count number modified (Nmod) total (Nvalid) reads position sample, calculate fraction modified bases two (FracMod). example, addition also calculate average modification probability (Pmod) average confidence modification calls per position (AvgConf). changed default keepReads = TRUE, addition also keep read-level assay input object (mod_prob) returned object. grouping reads sample mod_prob, dimensions read-level summary-level objects remain identical:

Alternatively, can also generate plot “modbase-space”, modified bases shown gaps removed:   6mA modifications can observed adenine positions. Heatmap plot type interpolate = TRUE fills unobserved positions read adenines using linear interpolation. makes plot appear smooth, taken grain salt: positions unobserved look different interpolated states.  mentioned , read-level data still contained summary object se_summary, can plot summary-level read-level data simultaneously object input:  also possible adapt settings individual tracks - details refer help page plotRegion(), arguments respective tracks listed.

title: Exploring read-level footprinting data with `footprintR`
text: Amongst things, single-molecule footprinting data allows measure average distance neighboring nucleosome particles, called nucleosome repeat length NRL. Traditionally, measured using MNase-seq data (phasogram analysis, see Valouev et al., Nature 2011, doi:10.1038/nature10002), required millions reads accurate estimate. switching measuring distances modified bases within reads, can extract much information per read already manage get accurate estimates handful reads:
code: moddist <- calcModbaseSpacing(se) print(estimateNRL(moddist$sample1)[1:2]) #> $nrl #> [1] 182.6 #>  #> $nrl.CI95 #>    2.5 %   97.5 %  #> 179.5475 185.6525 plotModbaseSpacing(moddist$sample1) plotModbaseSpacing(moddist$sample1, detailedPlots = TRUE)

code: library(SummarizedExperiment) modbamfiles <- system.file("extdata",                            c("6mA_1_10reads.bam", "6mA_2_10reads.bam"),                            package = "footprintR") se <- readModBam(modbamfiles, "chr1:6940000-6955000", "a",                   BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam()) lapply(assay(se, "mod_prob"), colnames) #> $s1 #> [1] "s1-233e48a7-f379-4dcf-9270-958231125563" #> [2] "s1-d52a5f6a-a60a-4f85-913e-eada84bfbfb9" #> [3] "s1-92e906ae-cddb-4347-a114-bf9137761a8d" #>  #> $s2 #> [1] "s2-034b625e-6230-4f8d-a713-3a32cd96c298" #> [2] "s2-d03efe3b-a45b-430b-9cb6-7e5882e4faf8" #>   # subset by read identifiers seSub <- subsetReads(se, c("s1-233e48a7-f379-4dcf-9270-958231125563",                            "s2-034b625e-6230-4f8d-a713-3a32cd96c298")) lapply(assay(seSub, "mod_prob"), colnames) #> $s1 #> [1] "s1-233e48a7-f379-4dcf-9270-958231125563" #>  #> $s2 #> [1] "s2-034b625e-6230-4f8d-a713-3a32cd96c298" #>   # subset by a list of indices seSub <- subsetReads(se, list(s1 = c(1, 3),                               s2 = c(TRUE, FALSE))) lapply(assay(seSub, "mod_prob"), colnames) #> $s1 #> [1] "s1-233e48a7-f379-4dcf-9270-958231125563" #> [2] "s1-92e906ae-cddb-4347-a114-bf9137761a8d" #>  #> $s2 #> [1] "s2-034b625e-6230-4f8d-a713-3a32cd96c298" #>

title: footprintR 0.3.0
text: Enable use flexible region specification readModBam() Add additional supported statistics flattenReadLevelAssay() (Sum Mean) Various smaller improvements bug fixes

title: footprintR 0.2.5
text: Expand readModBam allow direct extraction summary values (Nmod, Nvalid), use pileup approach quick extraction read-level values Add filterReadsBam() filter-reads input bam files write reads pass filters output bam files Add functions statistically identify differentially modified regions (scanForHighScoringRegions() helpers)

title: footprintR 0.2.4
text: Speed plotRegion() data sets many reads replacing .call() faster alternative Add option adjust facet heights number reads facet Add option squish reads (put one read row, possible) Change orderReads argument read-level plots logical character indicating type ordering

title: footprintR 0.2.3
text: Add addFootprints() helper functions calcFootprintScores() segmentFootprintScores() Add sampleAnnot argument reading functions enable inclusion additional sample annotations Add trim argument readModBam, restrict returned object specified regions Enable plotting read-specific (footprint) regions

title: footprintR 0.2.2
text: Rename facetBySample argument read-level plots facetBy, allowing facetting arbitrary sample column Add groupBy colorBy argument summary plots, specification arbitrary sample columns group color values Open using smoothing methods, specified via smoothMethod argument summary plots. Add ‘rollingMean’ first alternative smoothing splines Add progress bars expand messages track progress reading modbam files

title: footprintR 0.2.1
text: Refactor calcReadStats() (non-user facing changes) Add genomic region track type plotRegion() expose arguments individual track types Export helper functions create individual plotRegion() tracks Modify plotRegion() display exactly provided input region (minimal padding, restricting subregion observed data) Add support relative coordinate system plotRegion() Use 0.5 instead 1.0 label distance non-overlapping reads Modify getAnchorRegions() return RangedSummarizedExperiment object, allow user set anchor name

title: footprintR 0.2.0
text: Harmonize function argument names (using camelCase) Use BiocParallel::BPPARAM functions support parallel execution Rename addReadsSummary() flattenReadLevelAssay()

title: footprintR 0.1.4
text: Refactor plotRegion() use single tracks argument instead tracks.summary tracks.reads. Allow filterReads() return filter statistics table without subsetting SummarizedExperiment object. Add readModBam(..., variantPositions) argument adds labels reads, enabling allele specific analyses.
